title: Submitting the login form with an empty username shows a required-field message
steps: Leave the Username field empty; click into it and then blur it (tab away) without typing
expected_result: An inline validation message 'Username is required' appears under the Username field. No POST /api/login network call is made - the block is entirely client-side and the Login button click is a no-op. The user remains on /login.

title: Submitting the login form with an empty password shows a required-field message
steps: Leave the Password field empty; click into it and then blur it (tab away) without typing
expected_result: An inline validation message 'Password is required' appears under the Password field. No POST /api/login network call is made - the block is entirely client-side and the Login button click is a no-op. The user remains on /login.

title: Submitting the login form with both fields empty shows both required-field messages
steps: Leave both the Username and Password fields empty; click into and blur each one in turn
expected_result: Both 'Username is required' and 'Password is required' inline validation messages appear. No POST /api/login network call is made. The user remains on /login.
